Box Office पर Ramayana की तो चांदी हो गई है बॉस! 🔥

Nitesh Tiwari के डायरेक्शन और Namit Malhotra व Yash के प्रोडक्शन में बनी फिल्म Ramayana ने अपने दूसरे दिन 100.7 crore का तूफानी कलेक्शन करके हर किसी को हैरान कर दिया है।

फिल्म ने दूसरे दिन इंडिया में 56.7 crore और ओवरसीज में 44 crore की कमाई की, जिससे 2 दिनों का कुल worldwide collection 228.6 crore gross हो चुका है। 🚀

इसी के साथ Ramayana ने Yash की सुपरहिट फिल्म KGF Chapter 1 के 228.58 crore के रिकॉर्ड को पीछे छोड़ दिया है और यह Rocking Star की तीसरी सबसे ज्यादा कमाने वाली फिल्म बन गई है।

Pathaan, Jawan, Animal और Dhurandhar 2 के बाद लगातार दो दिनों तक 100 crore कमाने वाली यह बॉलीवुड की 5th फिल्म बन चुकी है। ✨

रिपोर्ट्स की मानें तो अपने 4-day extended opening weekend में यह फिल्म worldwide 500 crore mark को छू सकती है और आज Toxic का रिकॉर्ड भी तोड़ सकती है। 🔥

क्या आपको लगता है कि Ramayana वीकेंड खत्म होने तक 500 crore का आंकड़ा पार कर पाएगी? कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Ramayana Worldwide Box Office Day 2: Becomes Yash’s 3rd Highest-Grossing Film Of All Time
ctx.summary:
Ramayana picked up internationally on its second day, while domestically it maintained a strong hold on collections. 
 The post  Ramayana Worldwide Box Office Day 2: Becomes Yash’s 3rd Highest-Grossing Film Of All Time  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Ramayana maintained a good hold on its second day, adding 100 crore more to the tally. After Pathaan, Jawan, Animal, and Dhurandhar 2, it has become Bollywood’s fifth film to score 100 crore on two consecutive days. With the worldwide box office total already past 220 crore, it has become Yash’s third-highest-grossing film of all time by surpassing KGF Chapter 1 . Keep reading for a detailed collection report!
On the first Friday, the Bollywood magnum opus grossed 56.7 crore in India, a drop of 26.07% from the opening day’s 76.7 crore . Internationally, it grossed an estimated 44 crore yesterday, up 14.06% from Thursday’s 33.33 crore (excluding premieres), as word of mouth began to take hold. Overall, the film grossed 100.7 crore on its 2nd day.
In total, Ramayana stands at 133.4 crore in India and 95.2 crore overseas (including premieres), taking the 2-day worldwide box office collection to 228.6 crore gross. In its 4-day extended opening weekend, the film has a chance to hit the 500 crore mark worldwide.
With 228.6 crore coming in, Ramayana has surpassed KGF Chapter 1 ( 228.58 crore ) to become Yash’s third-highest-grossing film of all time. Today, on day 3, it is likely to cross Toxic ( 333.49 crore ) to secure the second spot. Given the favorable word-of-mouth, it is very much on track to become the Rocking Star’s top grosser.
Take a look at Yash’s highest-grossing films worldwide:
Ramayana is directed by Nitesh Tiwari and is produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash under the banner of Prime Focus Studios, Monster Mind Creations, and DNEG. It also stars Ravi Dubey, Arun Govil, Lara Dutta, Indira Krishnan, Rakul Preet Singh, Sonal Jha, Vivek Oberoi, and others. The music is composed by AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer.
